meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis on scientific data files across 200+ file formats. This skill should be used when analyzing any scientific data file to understand its structure, content, quality, and characteristics. Automatically detects file type and generates detailed markdown reports with format-specific analysis, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations. Covers chemistry, bioinformatics, microscopy, spectroscopy, proteomics, metabolomics, and general scientific data formats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析科学数据文件并生成详细报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解科学数据文件的结构和质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze scientific data files and generate detailed reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and quality of scientific data files

howto.what: 当用户提供科学数据文件路径时，Claude 会自动检测文件类型（支持 200+ 格式），进行格式特定的分析，并生成一份详细的 Markdown 报告，包含数据结构、质量评估和后续分析建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析、探索或总结一个科学数据文件时触发，例如说“分析这个文件”或“帮我看看这个数据”。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 FASTQ 文件，看看测序质量如何。
探索这个 CSV 数据集，告诉我有哪些列和缺失值。

howto.what_en: When a user provides a path to a scientific data file, Claude automatically detects the file type (200+ formats), performs format-specific analysis, and generates a detailed Markdown report covering data structure, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze, explore, or summarize a scientific data file, e.g., 'Analyze this file' or 'Help me look at this data'.

say_en.text: Analyze this FASTQ file and tell me about the sequencing quality.
Explore this CSV dataset and show me the columns and missing values.
